title: In the Journeys - Better Combat compat
description:
Better combat datapack compatibility for the mod:
-IN THE JOURNEYS-
body:
If you use **BETTER COMBAT** alongside **IN THE JOURNEYS**, this datapack makes them work together. It adds compatibility for the mod's custom weapons, giving them proper attack animations and behaviors so they integrate naturally with **Better Combat**.

![Some weapons with added compatibility](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53ad1966c9109f20755e96ce7388b55f940a4483.png)

Some weapons doesn't get **BETTER COMBAT SPELLS** since they already have custom abilities from **IN THE JOURNEYS** itself.
